author: Kushal
problem: speeds lists the hourly wind speeds at a wind turbine. The turbine generates power once the wind reaches cut_in, but shuts itself down for safety whenever the wind reaches cut_out. Return how many hours it generated power.
bug_description: Uses s <= cut_out instead of s < cut_out, so hours when the wind is exactly at the shutdown speed are counted as generating.

comments.accurate: Counts the hours the wind was in the turbine's generating range
comments.wrong_behavior: Counts the hours with wind speed between cut_in and cut_out, both included
comments.wrong_location: Speed range checked; speeds may be in a different unit from cut_in and cut_out
